instructions.ifClientControlsDomain: Prefer preserving esmermusic.com as the canonical public domain because reputable existing sources already link to it.
instructions.ifClientDoesNotControlDomain: Proceed with the full site and admin build using an environment/configurable canonical-domain value. Select the final domain later, then update canonicals, sitemap, structured data, OAuth redirect URIs, public links, and backlink outreach targets in one controlled change.
instructions.ifDomainCanBeAcquiredOrTransferred: Evaluate recovery/acquisition separately. Do not block implementation while that question is unresolved.
instructions.redirectRule: If control of esmermusic.com is obtained and a different canonical domain is selected, use permanent 301 redirects from the old inbound-link targets where technically possible.
